#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Source this file to use start_devnet/stop_devnet from another runner, or use
# `scripts/devnet.sh run -- command ...` to start a node for one command.
DEVNET_RPC_URL="${RPC_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:8547}"
# The PID file must be found by later invocations even if a subprocess changes
# TMPDIR, so use a stable path unless explicitly overridden.
DEVNET_STATE_DIR="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openzeppelin-stylus-devnet}"
DEVNET_PID_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/nitro-devnode.pid"
DEVNET_LOG_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/nitro-devnode.log"
DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
export DEPLOYER_ADDRESS="${DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:-0xcEcba2F1DC234f70Dd89F2041029807F8D03A990}"

devnet_rpc_is_ready() {
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 2 \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"net_version","params":[],"id":1}' \
    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi
    if grep -Fq 'Nitro node is running... (press Ctrl-C to stop)' \
      "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>/dev/null && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

start_devnet() {
  if devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
    return 0
  fi

  if [[ "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" != "http://127.0.0.1:8547" && \
        "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" != "http://localhost:8547" ]]; then
    printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
    return 1
  fi
  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the Nitro devnode.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }
  command -v cast >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Foundry cast is required by the Nitro devnode.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing Nitro devnode did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/nitro-devnode.sh" \
    >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'Nitro devnode did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '\nNitro devnode log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  return "${status}"
}

devnet_main() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    start)
      start_devnet
      printf 'Nitro devnode RPC: %s\n' "${RPC_URL}"
      ;;
    stop)
      stop_devnet --force
      ;;
    run)
      shift
      devnet_run "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh {start|stop|run -- command [args...]}\n' >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  set -euo pipefail
  devnet_main "$@"
fi

    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(<"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(awk -F= '/^RPC_URL=/ { print substr($0, 9); exit }' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
      export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

devnet_binary_path() {
  local target_directory
  target_directory="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '\nSDK Nitro devnet log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  return "${status}"
}

devnet_main() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    start)
      start_devnet
      printf 'SDK Nitro devnet RPC: %s\n' "${RPC_URL}"
      ;;
    stop)
      stop_devnet --force
      ;;
    run)
      shift
      devnet_run "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh {start|stop|run -- command [args...]}\n' >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  set -euo pipefail
  devnet_main "$@"
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Source this file to use start_devnet/stop_devnet from another runner, or use
# `scripts/devnet.sh run -- command ...` to share one SDK-managed Nitro node with
# that command. stylus-tools configures ArbOS and the Stylus system contracts.
DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL="${RPC_URL:-}"
DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
DEVNET_STATE_DIR="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openzeppelin-stylus-devnet}"
DEVNET_PID_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.pid"
DEVNET_RPC_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.rpc"
DEVNET_LOG_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.log"
DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
export DEPLOYER_ADDRESS="${DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:-0xcEcba2F1DC234f70Dd89F2041029807F8D03A990}"

devnet_rpc_is_ready() {
  [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] || return 1
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 2 \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"net_version","params":[],"id":1}' \
    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(<"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(awk -F= '/^RPC_URL=/ { print substr($0, 9); exit }' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
      export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

devnet_binary_path() {
  local target_directory
  target_directory="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '\nSDK Nitro devnet log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  return "${status}"
}

devnet_main() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    start)
      start_devnet
      printf 'SDK Nitro devnet RPC: %s\n' "${RPC_URL}"
      ;;
    stop)
      stop_devnet --force
      ;;
    run)
      shift
      devnet_run "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh {start|stop|run -- command [args...]}\n' >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  set -euo pipefail
  devnet_main "$@"
fi
use std::io::{self, Write};

use stylus_tools::devnet::Node;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> eyre::Result<()> {
    let node = Node::new().await?;

    println!("RPC_URL={}", node.rpc());
    io::stdout().flush()?;

    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        let mut terminate =
            tokio::signal::unix::signal(tokio::signal::unix::SignalKind::terminate())?;
        tokio::select! {
            result = tokio::signal::ctrl_c() => result?,
            _ = terminate.recv() => {},
        }
    }

    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await?;

    drop(node);
    Ok(())
}

    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '\nSDK Nitro devnet log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  return "${status}"
}

devnet_main() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    start)
      start_devnet
      printf 'SDK Nitro devnet RPC: %s\n' "${RPC_URL}"
      ;;
    stop)
      stop_devnet --force
      ;;
    run)
      shift
      devnet_run "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh {start|stop|run -- command [args...]}\n' >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  set -euo pipefail
  devnet_main "$@"
fi
use std::io::{self, Write};

use stylus_tools::devnet::Node;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main() -> eyre::Result<()> {
    let node = Node::new().await?;

    println!("RPC_URL={}", node.rpc());
    io::stdout().flush()?;

    #[cfg(unix)]
    {
        let mut terminate =
            tokio::signal::unix::signal(tokio::signal::unix::SignalKind::terminate())?;
        tokio::select! {
            result = tokio::signal::ctrl_c() => result?,
            _ = terminate.recv() => {},
        }
    }

    #[cfg(not(unix))]
    tokio::signal::ctrl_c().await?;

    drop(node);
    Ok(())
}

import re
import subprocess

paths = [
    "examples/uups-proxy/Cargo.toml",
    "examples/uups-proxy-new-version/Cargo.toml",
    "examples/uups-proxy/src/lib.rs",
    "examples/uups-proxy-new-version/src/lib.rs",
]
diff = subprocess.run(
    ["git", "diff", "--unified=0", "--", *paths],
    check=True,
    capture_output=True,
    text=True,
).stdout
blocks = re.split(r"(?=^diff --git )", diff, flags=re.MULTILINE)
selected = []
for block in blocks:
    if not block.strip():
        continue
    hunks = re.split(r"(?=^@@ )", block, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    header = hunks[0]
    path = header.split(" b/", 1)[1].splitlines()[0]
    chosen = []
    for hunk in hunks[1:]:
        if path.endswith("Cargo.toml"):
            keep = '+stylus-sdk = { workspace = true, features = ["stylus-test"] }' in hunk
        else:
            keep = "+#[cfg(test)]" in hunk and "+mod tests {" in hunk
        if keep:
            chosen.append(hunk)
    if chosen:
        selected.append(header + "".join(chosen))
patch = "".join(selected)
if not patch:
    raise SystemExit("No UUPS PoC hunks selected")
subprocess.run(
    ["git", "apply", "--cached", "--unidiff-zero"],
    input=patch,
    check=True,
    text=True,
)
print("Staged UUPS PoC hunks:")
for block in selected:
    print(block.splitlines()[0])
    for line in block.splitlines():
        if line.startswith("@@"):
            print(line)
PY

content.text:
You are in a clone of OpenZeppelin rust-contracts-stylus at release v0.3.0.

Goal: Stylus developers should be able to build contracts on this library with the
latest SDK, trust them with real money, and upgrade to it without surprises. Get the
whole library there.

Start by migrating it to Stylus SDK 0.10.10 on stable Rust 1.91.0.

Scope: the whole library. All contracts and extensions, contracts-proc, lib/crypto,
all examples, benches, fuzz targets and docs pages. lib/e2e and lib/e2e-proc are the
old E2E framework; the SDK's devnet tooling replaces them. Nothing is out of scope and
nothing may be commented out.

The migration must:
- replace global accessors with VM accessors,
- replace motsu with the Stylus testing framework,
- move the E2E tests to the SDK's devnet tooling,
- keep the benches working,
- keep the public ABI and behavior, unless a design change you document needs otherwise.

Done means: everything in scope builds and passes clippy and fmt. No global accessors,
no motsu. All unit tests, E2E tests and benches pass. Unit-test coverage is not lower
than on v0.3.0. Every E2E scenario from v0.3.0, success and failure, is still tested.
Storage layout stays compatible for contracts deployed behind a proxy, or every change
is in the upgrade guide. Every example in scope fits the WASM size limit and activates on
the devnet.

Then go further.

Use the new SDK fully:
- Read what changed in the Stylus SDK between 0.9.0 and 0.10.10. Use every change that
  makes this library better. Don't stop at making the old code compile.

Priorities for every design and refactor choice, in this order:
1. Developer experience: how easily consumers of the library compose the contracts and
   extensions in their own contracts.
2. Gas costs: measure them with the benches, before and after.
3. WASM size: every contract must fit the limit. Beyond that, size is not a goal.

Developers:
- Redesign the extensions where it makes them simpler to use and compose. Study how
  OpenZeppelin's Solidity, Cairo, Stellar and Sui Move contracts solve the same problems.
- Write the upgrade guide a developer on v0.3.0 needs: every breaking change and what
  to do about it.

Code:
- Apply KISS, SOLID and DRY to the code and tests. Merge examples and duplicate tests
  where no scenario is lost.
- Make rustdoc and the docs pages correct and consistent for the new API.

Evidence:
- Use the tools the best Rust security engineers use, not only unit tests: fuzzing or
  property tests, and differential tests against v0.3.0 behavior.
- Don't use mutation testing or formal verification (no cargo-mutants, no Kani).
- Aim for 100% coverage of the code in scope. It is reachable.

Security:
- Do a full security review of the code in scope. Look for what the reports in
  audits/ missed.
- List the invariants of each contract, then try to break each one.
- Describe every new finding: what breaks, how to trigger it, the impact and the
  severity.
- For each new bug, commit a failing PoC test first and the fix in a separate commit.
- Don't trust audits/. Check that every finding marked as resolved is really fixed.

Before you start:
- Check the environment. List every tool you will need for the whole task, including
  the evidence tools, with the version you found.
- Check that Docker is running.
- If anything is missing or has the wrong version, stop. Print what is missing and what
  you need, and do nothing else. Don't install anything yourself.
- If nothing is missing, say so and start.

How to work:
- After the check passes, work autonomously. Do not ask questions. When you face a decision, pick the best
  option, write down why, and move on.
- Plan the work yourself and use as many sub-agents as you need.
- Don't judge your own work. Trust only what a tool shows: a build, a test, a fuzzer.
- Don't stop until the migration is done and every check passes. If something in scope
  can't be made to work, say so. Don't hide it.
- Commit in small logical steps.

At the end write two files:
- MIGRATION.md: what changed and why, every decision, design changes, SDK features
  you adopted, gas and WASM size before and after, the evidence you produced, and the
  final output of all checks.
- SECURITY-REVIEW.md: scope, invariants, every finding (severity, description,
  impact, PoC, fix, and whether it is new or already in audits/), and the audit
  findings you checked.

### UUPS initializer takeover

**Severity: High for proxies using these examples.** This is an existing example flaw, not a migration regression or a numbered audit finding.

Both [the v1 initializer](/tmp/bench/ws/examples/uups-proxy/src/lib.rs:110) and [the v2 initializer](/tmp/bench/ws/examples/uups-proxy-new-version/src/lib.rs:129) are public and reset the owner without checking initialization state. Any caller can reinitialize an Alice-owned proxy as themselves, then use owner-only upgrades to take control. The current v1 E2E test already confirms that a second initialization changes the owner, though it calls as Alice rather than an attacker. V1→V2 upgrades also preserve the owner and automatically update the proxy’s version, but do not make v2’s initializer safe.

**Smallest fix:** In both example initializers, reject when the proxy-stored version is nonzero, returning the existing `InvalidInitialization` error. Keep the library’s `set_version` behavior unchanged. Its equality acceptance is intentional: it synchronizes the proxy to the active implementation, supports same-version upgrades, and is called after upgrades. It is not an application initializer guard. Using `owner == ZERO` alone would be unsafe because renouncing ownership makes the owner zero again. The deployment helper already initializes atomically in the proxy constructor.

**PoC tests:** Replace the test that expects repeat initialization to succeed. For v1, have Bob call `initialize(Bob)` on Alice’s initialized proxy; assert `InvalidInitialization` and that Alice remains owner. For v2, upgrade Alice’s proxy first, then make the same Bob call and assertions. Retain a separate test that calls `setVersion()` more than once to pin its intended idempotence.

These are source-derived attack traces; I did not run the tests. No files were modified.

I’m checking the failing deployment with cargo-stylus debug logging enabled. The captured test output shows the revert happens inside `cargo stylus deploy`, before the test reaches the initializer call; this trace should identify whether it is the fragment upload or constructor transaction.

The verbose trace now narrows the error to `cargo stylus`’s pre-deployment check: it reaches Wasm optimization, logs the RPC connection, then exits with the revert. #!/usr/bin/env bash

# Source this file to use start_devnet/stop_devnet from another runner, or use
# `scripts/devnet.sh run -- command ...` to share one SDK-managed Nitro node with
# that command. stylus-tools configures ArbOS and the Stylus system contracts.
DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DEVNET_ROOT_DIR="$(cd "${DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL="${RPC_URL:-}"
DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
DEVNET_STATE_DIR="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openzeppelin-stylus-devnet}"
DEVNET_PID_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.pid"
DEVNET_RPC_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.rpc"
DEVNET_LOG_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.log"
DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
export DEPLOYER_ADDRESS="${DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:-0xcEcba2F1DC234f70Dd89F2041029807F8D03A990}"

devnet_rpc_is_ready() {
  [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] || return 1
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 2 \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"net_version","params":[],"id":1}' \
    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(<"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(awk -F= '/^RPC_URL=/ { print substr($0, 9); exit }' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
      export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

devnet_binary_path() {
  local target_directory
  target_directory="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" \
    -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then

  printf 'Source scripts/wasm-opt-wrapper/env.sh before running cargo stylus.\n' >&2

"${OZ_WASM_OPT_REAL}" "$@"

arguments=("$@")
output=''
for ((index = 0; index < ${#arguments[@]}; index++)); do
  case "${arguments[index]}" in

      if ((index + 1 < ${#arguments[@]})); then
        output="${arguments[index + 1]}"
      fi
      ;;
    --output=*)

      ;;
  esac

wat_file="${output}.wat"

cleanup() {

}

if rg -q '\(memory\.init|\(data\.drop' "${wat_file}"; then

rm -f "${wat_file}"

You are in a clone of OpenZeppelin rust-contracts-stylus at release v0.3.0.

Goal: Stylus developers should be able to build contracts on this library with the
latest SDK, trust them with real money, and upgrade to it without surprises. Get the
whole library there.

Start by migrating it to Stylus SDK 0.10.10 on stable Rust 1.91.0.

Scope: the whole library. All contracts and extensions, contracts-proc, lib/crypto,
all examples, benches, fuzz targets and docs pages. lib/e2e and lib/e2e-proc are the
old E2E framework; the SDK's devnet tooling replaces them. Nothing is out of scope and
nothing may be commented out.

The migration must:
- replace global accessors with VM accessors,
- replace motsu with the Stylus testing framework,
- move the E2E tests to the SDK's devnet tooling,
- keep the benches working,
- keep the public ABI and behavior, unless a design change you document needs otherwise.

Done means: everything in scope builds and passes clippy and fmt. No global accessors,
no motsu. All unit tests, E2E tests and benches pass. Unit-test coverage is not lower
than on v0.3.0. Every E2E scenario from v0.3.0, success and failure, is still tested.
Storage layout stays compatible for contracts deployed behind a proxy, or every change
is in the upgrade guide. Every example in scope fits the WASM size limit and activates on
the devnet.

Then go further.

Use the new SDK fully:
- Read what changed in the Stylus SDK between 0.9.0 and 0.10.10. Use every change that
  makes this library better. Don't stop at making the old code compile.

Priorities for every design and refactor choice, in this order:
1. Developer experience: how easily consumers of the library compose the contracts and
   extensions in their own contracts.
2. Gas costs: measure them with the benches, before and after.
3. WASM size: every contract must fit the limit. Beyond that, size is not a goal.

Developers:
- Redesign the extensions where it makes them simpler to use and compose. Study how
  OpenZeppelin's Solidity, Cairo, Stellar and Sui Move contracts solve the same problems.
- Write the upgrade guide a developer on v0.3.0 needs: every breaking change and what
  to do about it.

Code:
- Apply KISS, SOLID and DRY to the code and tests. Merge examples and duplicate tests
  where no scenario is lost.
- Make rustdoc and the docs pages correct and consistent for the new API.

Evidence:
- Use the tools the best Rust security engineers use, not only unit tests: fuzzing or
  property tests, and differential tests against v0.3.0 behavior.
- Don't use mutation testing or formal verification (no cargo-mutants, no Kani).
- Aim for 100% coverage of the code in scope. It is reachable.

Security:
- Do a full security review of the code in scope. Look for what the reports in
  audits/ missed.
- List the invariants of each contract, then try to break each one.
- Describe every new finding: what breaks, how to trigger it, the impact and the
  severity.
- For each new bug, commit a failing PoC test first and the fix in a separate commit.
- Don't trust audits/. Check that every finding marked as resolved is really fixed.

Before you start:
- Check the environment. List every tool you will need for the whole task, including
  the evidence tools, with the version you found.
- Check that Docker is running.
- If anything is missing or has the wrong version, stop. Print what is missing and what
  you need, and do nothing else. Don't install anything yourself.
- If nothing is missing, say so and start.

How to work:
- After the check passes, work autonomously. Do not ask questions. When you face a decision, pick the best
  option, write down why, and move on.
- Plan the work yourself and use as many sub-agents as you need.
- Don't judge your own work. Trust only what a tool shows: a build, a test, a fuzzer.
- Don't stop until the migration is done and every check passes. If something in scope
  can't be made to work, say so. Don't hide it.
- Commit in small logical steps.

At the end write two files:
- MIGRATION.md: what changed and why, every decision, design changes, SDK features
  you adopted, gas and WASM size before and after, the evidence you produced, and the
  final output of all checks.
- SECURITY-REVIEW.md: scope, invariants, every finding (severity, description,
  impact, PoC, fix, and whether it is new or already in audits/), and the audit
  findings you checked.

### UUPS initializer takeover

**Severity: High for proxies using these examples.** This is an existing example flaw, not a migration regression or a numbered audit finding.

Both [the v1 initializer](/tmp/bench/ws/examples/uups-proxy/src/lib.rs:110) and [the v2 initializer](/tmp/bench/ws/examples/uups-proxy-new-version/src/lib.rs:129) are public and reset the owner without checking initialization state. Any caller can reinitialize an Alice-owned proxy as themselves, then use owner-only upgrades to take control. The current v1 E2E test already confirms that a second initialization changes the owner, though it calls as Alice rather than an attacker. V1→V2 upgrades also preserve the owner and automatically update the proxy’s version, but do not make v2’s initializer safe.

**Smallest fix:** In both example initializers, reject when the proxy-stored version is nonzero, returning the existing `InvalidInitialization` error. Keep the library’s `set_version` behavior unchanged. Its equality acceptance is intentional: it synchronizes the proxy to the active implementation, supports same-version upgrades, and is called after upgrades. It is not an application initializer guard. Using `owner == ZERO` alone would be unsafe because renouncing ownership makes the owner zero again. The deployment helper already initializes atomically in the proxy constructor.

**PoC tests:** Replace the test that expects repeat initialization to succeed. For v1, have Bob call `initialize(Bob)` on Alice’s initialized proxy; assert `InvalidInitialization` and that Alice remains owner. For v2, upgrade Alice’s proxy first, then make the same Bob call and assertions. Retain a separate test that calls `setVersion()` more than once to pin its intended idempotence.

These are source-derived attack traces; I did not run the tests. No files were modified.

I’m adding the two adversarial E2E cases first, then I’ll run them against the unfixed implementation and commit only the failing tests. I’ll keep the migration’s other in-progress changes out of both commits.

I’m rerunning one deployment with Stylus debug logging enabled. The current test log establishes the failure occurs after artifact optimization, but it doesn’t identify which deployment step makes the reverting RPC call.

I’m checking the failing deployment with cargo-stylus debug logging enabled. The captured test output shows the revert happens inside `cargo stylus deploy`, before the test reaches the initializer call; this trace should identify whether it is the fragment upload or constructor transaction.

The verbose trace now narrows the error to `cargo stylus`’s pre-deployment check: it reaches Wasm optimization, logs the RPC connection, then exits with the revert. No fragment transaction, deployer call, contract address, or activation appears, so the constructor was not reached. I’m capturing the complete output to a temporary log for the handoff.

The UUPS red runs are complete and Cargo is free for the F-04 work. I’m checking the shared devnet runner and workspace structure now so I can settle the SDK Node helper path without competing for the build lock.
The F04 agent has confirmed it is waiting. I’m regenerating the lockfile for Alloy 1.7.3 now, then I’ll return the Cargo window to security_review so it can run its captured PoCs.
F04’s Cargo work has finished. I’m running the focused UUPS unit tests first, then building the SDK Node helper and running the UUPS E2E suite on that helper-managed node.

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Source this file to use start_devnet/stop_devnet from another runner, or use
# `scripts/devnet.sh run -- command ...` to share one SDK-managed Nitro node with
# that command. stylus-tools configures ArbOS and the Stylus system contracts.
DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DEVNET_ROOT_DIR="$(cd "${DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL="${RPC_URL:-}"
DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
DEVNET_STATE_DIR="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openzeppelin-stylus-devnet}"
DEVNET_PID_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.pid"
DEVNET_RPC_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.rpc"
DEVNET_LOG_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.log"
DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
export DEPLOYER_ADDRESS="${DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:-0xcEcba2F1DC234f70Dd89F2041029807F8D03A990}"

devnet_rpc_is_ready() {
  [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] || return 1
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 2 \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"net_version","params":[],"id":1}' \
    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(<"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(awk -F= '/^RPC_URL=/ { print substr($0, 9); exit }' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
      export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

devnet_binary_path() {
  local target_directory
  target_directory="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" \
    -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
    }));

    Ok(())
}

#[tokio::test]
async fn flash_loan_with_fee() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Account::new().await?;

    let erc20_addr = alice.as_deployer().deploy().await?.contract_address;
    let erc20 = Erc20FlashMint::new(erc20_addr, &alice.wallet);
    _ = watch!(erc20.setFlashFeeReceiver(Address::ZERO))?;
    _ = watch!(erc20.setFlashFeeValue(FLASH_FEE_VALUE))?;

    let borrower_addr = borrower::deploy(&alice.wallet, true, true).await?;
    watch!(erc20.mint(borrower_addr, FLASH_FEE_VALUE))?;
    let loan_amount = uint!(1_000_000_U256);

    let borrower_balance = erc20.balanceOf(borrower_addr).call().await?;
    let total_supply = erc20.totalSupply().call().await?;

    assert_eq!(FLASH_FEE_VALUE, borrower_balance);
    assert_eq!(FLASH_FEE_VALUE, total_supply);

    let receipt = receipt!(erc20.flashLoan(
        borrower_addr,
        erc20_addr,
        loan_amount,
        vec![].into()
    ))?;

    assert!(receipt.emits(Erc20FlashMint::Transfer {
        from: Address::ZERO,
        to: borrower_addr,
        value: loan_amount,
    }));
    assert!(receipt.emits(ERC3156FlashBorrowerMock::BalanceOf {
        token: erc20_addr,
        account: borrower_addr,
        value: loan_amount + FLASH_FEE_VALUE,
    }));

#[tokio::test]
async fn flash_loan_with_fee() -> Result<()> {
    let alice = Account::new().await?;

    let erc20_addr = alice.as_deployer().deploy().await?.contract_address;
    let erc20 = Erc20FlashMint::new(erc20_addr, &alice.wallet);
    _ = watch!(erc20.setFlashFeeReceiver(Address::ZERO))?;
    _ = watch!(erc20.setFlashFeeValue(FLASH_FEE_VALUE))?;

    let borrower_addr = borrower::deploy(&alice.wallet, true, true).await?;
    watch!(erc20.mint(borrower_addr, FLASH_FEE_VALUE))?;
    let loan_amount = uint!(1_000_000_U256);

    let borrower_balance = erc20.balanceOf(borrower_addr).call().await?;
    let total_supply = erc20.totalSupply().call().await?;

    assert_eq!(FLASH_FEE_VALUE, borrower_balance);
    assert_eq!(FLASH_FEE_VALUE, total_supply);

    let receipt = receipt!(erc20.flashLoan(
        borrower_addr,
        erc20_addr,
        loan_amount,
        vec![].into()
    ))?;

    assert!(receipt.emits(Erc20FlashMint::Transfer {
        from: Address::ZERO,
        to: borrower_addr,
        value: loan_amount,
    }));
    assert!(receipt.emits(ERC3156FlashBorrowerMock::BalanceOf {
        token: erc20_addr,
        account: borrower_addr,
        value: loan_amount + FLASH_FEE_VALUE,
    }));

### UUPS initializer takeover

**Severity: High for proxies using these examples.** This is an existing example flaw, not a migration regression or a numbered audit finding.

Both [the v1 initializer](/tmp/bench/ws/examples/uups-proxy/src/lib.rs:110) and [the v2 initializer](/tmp/bench/ws/examples/uups-proxy-new-version/src/lib.rs:129) are public and reset the owner without checking initialization state. Any caller can reinitialize an Alice-owned proxy as themselves, then use owner-only upgrades to take control. The current v1 E2E test already confirms that a second initialization changes the owner, though it calls as Alice rather than an attacker. V1→V2 upgrades also preserve the owner and automatically update the proxy’s version, but do not make v2’s initializer safe.

**Smallest fix:** In both example initializers, reject when the proxy-stored version is nonzero, returning the existing `InvalidInitialization` error. Keep the library’s `set_version` behavior unchanged. Its equality acceptance is intentional: it synchronizes the proxy to the active implementation, supports same-version upgrades, and is called after upgrades. It is not an application initializer guard. Using `owner == ZERO` alone would be unsafe because renouncing ownership makes the owner zero again. The deployment helper already initializes atomically in the proxy constructor.

**PoC tests:** Replace the test that expects repeat initialization to succeed. For v1, have Bob call `initialize(Bob)` on Alice’s initialized proxy; assert `InvalidInitialization` and that Alice remains owner. For v2, upgrade Alice’s proxy first, then make the same Bob call and assertions. Retain a separate test that calls `setVersion()` more than once to pin its intended idempotence.

These are source-derived attack traces; I did not run the tests. No files were modified.

I’m adding the two adversarial E2E cases first, then I’ll run them against the unfixed implementation and commit only the failing tests. I’ll keep the migration’s other in-progress changes out of both commits.

I’m rerunning one deployment with Stylus debug logging enabled. The current test log establishes the failure occurs after artifact optimization, but it doesn’t identify which deployment step makes the reverting RPC call.

I’m checking the failing deployment with cargo-stylus debug logging enabled. The captured test output shows the revert happens inside `cargo stylus deploy`, before the test reaches the initializer call; this trace should identify whether it is the fragment upload or constructor transaction.

The verbose trace now narrows the error to `cargo stylus`’s pre-deployment check: it reaches Wasm optimization, logs the RPC connection, then exits with the revert. No fragment transaction, deployer call, contract address, or activation appears, so the constructor was not reached. I’m capturing the complete output to a temporary log for the handoff.

The UUPS red runs are complete and Cargo is free for the F-04 work. I’m checking the shared devnet runner and workspace structure now so I can settle the SDK Node helper path without competing for the build lock.
The F04 agent has confirmed it is waiting. I’m regenerating the lockfile for Alloy 1.7.3 now, then I’ll return the Cargo window to security_review so it can run its captured PoCs.
F04’s Cargo work has finished. I’m running the focused UUPS unit tests first, then building the SDK Node helper and running the UUPS E2E suite on that helper-managed node.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
cd "${ROOT_DIR}"
source "${ROOT_DIR}/scripts/devnet.sh"
source "${ROOT_DIR}/scripts/wasm-opt-wrapper/env.sh"

cleanup() {
  local status=$?
  trap - EXIT INT TERM
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
    printf '\nNitro devnode log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  exit "${status}"
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM

start_devnet

E2E_PACKAGES=()
while IFS= read -r package; do
  E2E_PACKAGES+=("${package}")
done < <(
  find examples -mindepth 2 -maxdepth 2 -name Cargo.toml -print0 |
    while IFS= read -r -d '' manifest; do
      if grep -Eq '^e2e[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*\[\]' "${manifest}"; then
        awk '
          /^\[package\]/ { package = 1; next }
          /^\[/ { package = 0 }
          package && /^name[[:space:]]*=/ {
            gsub(/"/, "", $3)
            print $3
            exit
          }
        ' "${manifest}"
      fi
    done | sort -u
)

if [[ ${#E2E_PACKAGES[@]} -eq 0 ]]; then
  printf 'No example packages define the e2e feature.\n' >&2
  exit 1
fi

PACKAGE_ARGS=()
for package in "${E2E_PACKAGES[@]}"; do
  PACKAGE_ARGS+=(--package "${package}")
done

if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_PANIC=unwind cargo test --locked --features e2e \
    "${PACKAGE_ARGS[@]}" --test '*' -- --test-threads=1
else
  CARGO_PROFILE_DEV_PANIC=unwind cargo test --locked --features e2e "$@"
fi
#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Source this file to use start_devnet/stop_devnet from another runner, or use
# `scripts/devnet.sh run -- command ...` to share one SDK-managed Nitro node with
# that command. stylus-tools configures ArbOS and the Stylus system contracts.
DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DEVNET_ROOT_DIR="$(cd "${DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL="${RPC_URL:-}"
DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
DEVNET_STATE_DIR="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openzeppelin-stylus-devnet}"
DEVNET_PID_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.pid"
DEVNET_RPC_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.rpc"
DEVNET_LOG_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.log"
DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
export DEPLOYER_ADDRESS="${DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:-0xcEcba2F1DC234f70Dd89F2041029807F8D03A990}"

devnet_rpc_is_ready() {
  [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] || return 1
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 2 \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"net_version","params":[],"id":1}' \
    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(<"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(awk -F= '/^RPC_URL=/ { print substr($0, 9); exit }' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
      export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

devnet_binary_path() {
  local target_directory
  target_directory="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" \
    -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2

#!/usr/bin/env bash

# Source this file to use start_devnet/stop_devnet from another runner, or use
# `scripts/devnet.sh run -- command ...` to share one SDK-managed Nitro node with
# that command. stylus-tools configures ArbOS and the Stylus system contracts.
DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
DEVNET_ROOT_DIR="$(cd "${DEVNET_SCRIPT_DIR}/.." && pwd)"
DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL="${RPC_URL:-}"
DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
DEVNET_STATE_DIR="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR:-/tmp/openzeppelin-stylus-devnet}"
DEVNET_PID_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.pid"
DEVNET_RPC_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.rpc"
DEVNET_LOG_FILE="${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}/sdk-devnet.log"
DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
export DEPLOYER_ADDRESS="${DEPLOYER_ADDRESS:-0xcEcba2F1DC234f70Dd89F2041029807F8D03A990}"

devnet_rpc_is_ready() {
  [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] || return 1
  curl --silent --show-error --fail --max-time 2 \
    --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"net_version","params":[],"id":1}' \
    "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" | grep -q '"result"'
}

devnet_wait_until_ready() {
  for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 600; attempt++)); do
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]] && ! kill -0 "${DEVNET_PID}" 2>/dev/null; then
      return 1
    fi

    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(<"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -z "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" && -f "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" ]]; then
      DEVNET_RPC_URL="$(awk -F= '/^RPC_URL=/ { print substr($0, 9); exit }' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}")"
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]] && devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >"${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
      export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
      return 0
    fi
    sleep 0.5
  done
  return 1
}

devnet_binary_path() {
  local target_directory
  target_directory="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" |
    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" \
    -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '\nSDK Nitro devnet log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  return "${status}"
}

devnet_main() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    start)
      start_devnet
      printf 'SDK Nitro devnet RPC: %s\n' "${RPC_URL}"
      ;;
    stop)
      stop_devnet --force
      ;;
    run)
      shift
      devnet_run "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh {start|stop|run -- command [args...]}\n' >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

if [[ "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" == "$0" ]]; then
  set -euo pipefail
  devnet_main "$@"
fi

  )

    python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["target_directory"])')"
  printf '%s/stylus-devnet-node\n' "${target_directory}/debug"
}

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
      DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
      if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
        unset DEVNET_PID
        return 0
      fi
      printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
      cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
      return 1
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" \
    -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
      kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
      sleep 0.1
    done
    if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
    if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
      wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?
  if [[ ${status} -ne 0 ]]; then
    printf '\nSDK Nitro devnet log (%s):\n' "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
  fi
  stop_devnet
  return "${status}"
}

devnet_main() {
  case "${1:-}" in
    start)
      start_devnet
      printf 'SDK Nitro devnet RPC: %s\n' "${RPC_URL}"
      ;;
    stop)
      stop_devnet --force
      ;;
    run)
      shift
      devnet_run "$@"
      ;;
    *)
      printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh {start|stop|run -- command [args...]}\n' >&2
      return 2
      ;;
  esac
}

  devnet_main "$@"

start_devnet() {
  if [[ -n "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    DEVNET_RPC_URL="${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}"
    if ! devnet_rpc_is_ready; then
      printf 'RPC endpoint is unavailable: %s\n' "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" >&2
      return 1
    fi
    export RPC_URL="${DEVNET_RPC_URL}"
    return 0
  fi

  mkdir -p "${DEVNET_STATE_DIR}"
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    local existing_pid
    existing_pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
    if [[ "${existing_pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${existing_pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
      local process_command
      process_command="$(ps -p "${existing_pid}" -o command= 2>/dev/null || true)"
      if [[ "${process_command}" == *"stylus-devnet-node"* ]]; then
        DEVNET_PID="${existing_pid}"
        DEVNET_RPC_URL=""
        if devnet_wait_until_ready; then
          unset DEVNET_PID
          return 0
        fi
        printf 'Existing SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
        cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 2>/dev/null || true
        return 1
      fi
    fi
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi

  command -v docker >/dev/null || {
    printf 'Docker is required to start the SDK Nitro devnet.\n' >&2
    return 1
  }

  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "${DEVNET_ROOT_DIR}/Cargo.toml" \
    -p stylus-devnet-node
  local binary
  binary="$(devnet_binary_path)"
  if [[ ! -x "${binary}" ]]; then
    printf 'SDK devnet helper was not built at %s\n' "${binary}" >&2
    return 1
  fi

  : >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}"
  nohup "${binary}" >"${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" 2>&1 </dev/null &
  DEVNET_PID=$!
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=1
  printf '%s\n' "${DEVNET_PID}" >"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp"
  mv "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}.tmp" "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}"

  if ! devnet_wait_until_ready; then
    printf 'SDK Nitro devnet did not become ready.\n' >&2
    cat "${DEVNET_LOG_FILE}" >&2 || true
    stop_devnet
    return 1
  fi
}

start_clean_devnet() {
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    stop_devnet --force
  fi
  start_devnet
}

stop_devnet() {
  local force=0
  if [[ "${1:-}" == "--force" ]]; then
    force=1
  fi
  if [[ "${DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER}" != 1 && "${force}" != 1 ]]; then
    return 0
  fi

  local pid="${DEVNET_PID:-}"
  if [[ -z "${pid}" && -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" ]]; then
    pid="$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")"
  fi
  if [[ "${pid}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]] && kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
    local process_command
    process_command="$(ps -p "${pid}" -o command= 2>/dev/null || true)"
    if [[ "${process_command}" == *"stylus-devnet-node"* ]]; then
      kill -TERM "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
      for ((attempt = 0; attempt < 100; attempt++)); do
        kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || break
        sleep 0.1
      done
      if kill -0 "${pid}" 2>/dev/null; then
        kill -KILL "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
      if [[ -n "${DEVNET_PID:-}" ]]; then
        wait "${pid}" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    else
      pid=""
    fi
  fi
  if [[ -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" && "$(<"${DEVNET_PID_FILE}")" == "${pid}" ]]; then
    rm -f "${DEVNET_PID_FILE}" "${DEVNET_RPC_FILE}"
  fi
  if [[ -z "${DEVNET_EXPLICIT_RPC_URL}" && "${RPC_URL:-}" == "${DEVNET_RPC_URL}" ]]; then
    unset RPC_URL
  fi
  unset DEVNET_PID
  DEVNET_STARTED_BY_CALLER=0
}

devnet_run() {
  if [[ "${1:-}" != -- ]]; then
    printf 'Usage: scripts/devnet.sh run -- command [args...]\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi
  shift
  if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    printf 'A command is required after --.\n' >&2
    return 2
  fi

  start_devnet || return
  local status=0
  "$@" || status=$?

content.text:
You are in a clone of OpenZeppelin rust-contracts-stylus at release v0.3.0.

Goal: Stylus developers should be able to build contracts on this library with the
latest SDK, trust them with real money, and upgrade to it without surprises. Get the
whole library there.

Start by migrating it to Stylus SDK 0.10.10 on stable Rust 1.91.0.

Scope: the whole library. All contracts and extensions, contracts-proc, lib/crypto,
all examples, benches, fuzz targets and docs pages. lib/e2e and lib/e2e-proc are the
old E2E framework; the SDK's devnet tooling replaces them. Nothing is out of scope and
nothing may be commented out.

The migration must:
- replace global accessors with VM accessors,
- replace motsu with the Stylus testing framework,
- move the E2E tests to the SDK's devnet tooling,
- keep the benches working,
- keep the public ABI and behavior, unless a design change you document needs otherwise.

Done means: everything in scope builds and passes clippy and fmt. No global accessors,
no motsu. All unit tests, E2E tests and benches pass. Unit-test coverage is not lower
than on v0.3.0. Every E2E scenario from v0.3.0, success and failure, is still tested.
Storage layout stays compatible for contracts deployed behind a proxy, or every change
is in the upgrade guide. Every example in scope fits the WASM size limit and activates on
the devnet.

Then go further.

Use the new SDK fully:
- Read what changed in the Stylus SDK between 0.9.0 and 0.10.10. Use every change that
  makes this library better. Don't stop at making the old code compile.

Priorities for every design and refactor choice, in this order:
1. Developer experience: how easily consumers of the library compose the contracts and
   extensions in their own contracts.
2. Gas costs: measure them with the benches, before and after.
3. WASM size: every contract must fit the limit. Beyond that, size is not a goal.

Developers:
- Redesign the extensions where it makes them simpler to use and compose. Study how
  OpenZeppelin's Solidity, Cairo, Stellar and Sui Move contracts solve the same problems.
- Write the upgrade guide a developer on v0.3.0 needs: every breaking change and what
  to do about it.

Code:
- Apply KISS, SOLID and DRY to the code and tests. Merge examples and duplicate tests
  where no scenario is lost.
- Make rustdoc and the docs pages correct and consistent for the new API.

Evidence:
- Use the tools the best Rust security engineers use, not only unit tests: fuzzing or
  property tests, and differential tests against v0.3.0 behavior.
- Don't use mutation testing or formal verification (no cargo-mutants, no Kani).
- Aim for 100% coverage of the code in scope. It is reachable.

Security:
- Do a full security review of the code in scope. Look for what the reports in
  audits/ missed.
- List the invariants of each contract, then try to break each one.
- Describe every new finding: what breaks, how to trigger it, the impact and the
  severity.
- For each new bug, commit a failing PoC test first and the fix in a separate commit.
- Don't trust audits/. Check that every finding marked as resolved is really fixed.

Before you start:
- Check the environment. List every tool you will need for the whole task, including
  the evidence tools, with the version you found.
- Check that Docker is running.
- If anything is missing or has the wrong version, stop. Print what is missing and what
  you need, and do nothing else. Don't install anything yourself.
- If nothing is missing, say so and start.

How to work:
- After the check passes, work autonomously. Do not ask questions. When you face a decision, pick the best
  option, write down why, and move on.
- Plan the work yourself and use as many sub-agents as you need.
- Don't judge your own work. Trust only what a tool shows: a build, a test, a fuzzer.
- Don't stop until the migration is done and every check passes. If something in scope
  can't be made to work, say so. Don't hide it.
- Commit in small logical steps.

At the end write two files:
- MIGRATION.md: what changed and why, every decision, design changes, SDK features
  you adopted, gas and WASM size before and after, the evidence you produced, and the
  final output of all checks.
- SECURITY-REVIEW.md: scope, invariants, every finding (severity, description,
  impact, PoC, fix, and whether it is new or already in audits/), and the audit
  findings you checked.
